notes: Annual date string includes features overlapping that year.
Decimal years use 0.0 for 1 BCE, -1.0 for 2 BCE; preserve the app civil-year distinction.
All date fields optional in upstream plugin. For a default historical detail layer, do not silently treat unbounded modern-looking features as ancient.
Use existing Meridian terrain/coast styles, not the entire OHM basemap.
CC0 is the default dedication, with per-element license and attribution exceptions.
Preserve central and feature-level attribution; do not relabel the whole database as uniformly CC0.
Some coast/water imports from 2012 OSM are CC BY-SA 2.0; the planned historical transport/building layer should not import those water layers.
Preserve OHM central copyright/source links for imported data exceptions; the public vector API does not expose feature-level license/source tags.

nextChecks: Continue regional source enrichment and historical review; online coverage remains uneven.

notes: Road features have osm_id, class/type, start_date/end_date, decimal date fields. Per-element sources are not in the sampled vector tile properties.
Building polygons carry decimal dates but no IDs or names in the sampled source layer. Never invent a per-building source link.
Settlement points support localized name_zh/name_en and other languages, but some names may need explicit Simplified Chinese normalization.
Default historical detail should require a valid numeric start_decdate, omitting end-only and undated records. Known but unparseable end dates must not be treated as ongoing.

dateConvention.rule: OHM ISO -4000 corresponds to 4001 BCE. Convert Meridian civil year y<0 to astronomical y+1. Annual interval is [astronomicalYear, astronomicalYear+1). Features overlap when start_decdate < yearEnd and no end_decdate or end_decdate >= yearStart.
dateConvention.notes: Pinned current plugin returns UTC astronomical years directly; do not introduce the older negative-year adjustment.

runtime.datePolicy: Known starts, annual overlap, valid ends, ordered intervals; civil-to-astronomical conversion; construction/proposed transport omitted.
